item.title: Fire rages through Orleans garage
item.description: ORLEANS – Fire erupted in a detached garage in Orleans around 10:15 PM Thursday. Firefighters responded to the scene on Brick Hill Road to find the garage fully involved. item.title: Two holiday rounds of snow for Cape Cod
item.description: HYANNIS – Cape Cod received a top total of four-and-a-half inches of snow on New Year’s Eve and New Year’s Day, according to the National Weather Service. The highest accumulations were measured in Chatham and Dennis. The NWS said snow also was reported across the Upper and Lower Cape and in Barnstable.
